name: Onna no Ko no Egakikata
source:
Aoyama just joined the manga club, so the president and another member have
decided to show him how to draw a girl. They say that experience is important,
so they have one of the female club members come help.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ299818/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
青山刚加入漫画研究会，社长和另一名成员便决定教他如何画女孩子。他们说实践很重要，于是请来一位女性社员帮忙示范。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ299818/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
